resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLA gives 39.11827, -76.16344 for the Orchard Point entry; TopoQuest gives 39.137610, -76.146338 for the cape. The two points do not match, so the FFLA entry may not sit on the cape.

corrections.why: '(unknown)' is FFLA's label on the entry, not a separate name. The FFLA page gives no alternate name.

corrections.current: FFLA marks this entry 'unknown': details are uncertain.
corrections.proposed: FFLA lists the entry as 'Orchard Point (unknown)' and gives no other detail.
corrections.why: The FFLA page shows '(unknown)' as part of the entry name only; it does not say the details are uncertain.

sources.title: Forestry Towers and Forestry Tower Properties: A Resource Document

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. FFLA is the only source naming a tower at this point, and its entry carries only the name, county, coordinates and the word 'unknown'. TopoQuest identifies a cape of the same name in Kent County, at coordinates that do not match the FFLA entry. Two searches found no tower history, owner or access note. The 2007 DNR report's list of towers has no Kent County entry. Proposed corrections: remove '(unknown)' from other_names, and reword status_note because the FFLA page does not say details are uncertain. Recommend confirming with FFLA what the entry refers to before keeping it as standing.
